findings.claim: Micron held roughly 11% HBM market share as of its December 2025 announcement, when it also said it plans to exit the consumer memory/storage market to prioritize AI data-center customers.

findings.claim: China's CXMT is projected to reach ~350,000 wafer starts per month of DRAM capacity by end-2026 — only ~25,000 WSPM behind Micron — putting CXMT in 4th place globally in DRAM (behind Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron) and on track to make China the world's second-largest DRAM production base.

findings.claim: Some Chinese PC/memory-module brands (cited: Corsair, HP, Dell) have begun sourcing homegrown DDR5 chips from CXMT and YMTC instead of Samsung, Micron and SK Hynix.

findings.claim: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra pushed the US Congress to restrict chip-equipment access for CXMT, YMTC and SMIC, warning that Chinese state-backed investment poses a competitive threat comparable to China's dominance of the solar industry.
findings.source: Taipei Times, "Micron pushes US Congress to curb Chinese competitors"

findings.claim: Micron is certified and in high-volume production as an HBM4 supplier for Nvidia's Vera Rubin AI platform; its entire calendar-2026 HBM4 capacity is committed under binding contracts, including Micron's first five-year customer agreement (unusually long for the sector). Samsung and SK Hynix are also confirmed HBM4 suppliers for Vera Rubin, i.e. Micron is not the exclusive supplier.
findings.source: Micron Technology investor press release, "Micron in High-Volume Production of HBM4 Designed for NVIDIA Vera Rubin, PCIe Gen6 SSD and SOCAMM2"

competitive_share_entrants.note: HBM 分軸市佔數字跨來源打架：Counterpoint 系列估 Micron 個位數~11%、SK Hynix ~50%、Samsung ~33-40%；但 Astute Group 標題稱『Micron overtakes Samsung』，與前者矛盾，兩邊都未附一致口徑（出貨額 vs 出貨量 vs 產能）之說明，本軸未強行調和，僅並陳附來源，留給判斷層處理。CXMT/YMTC 兩則 as_of 為來源集群推估月份（URL 含 2026/07），非文章明確發布日期，如需精確日期建議 WebFetch 複驗。

substitute_technology.note: 另查到 Qualcomm 傳出在開發整合運算與低功耗 DRAM 的 3D 堆疊記憶體（規劃 2027 年中送樣），可能與 HBM 競爭；但兩次 WebFetch（EnkiAI、NAND Research 文章）都查不到此說法的原始出處與確切日期，無法滿足 sourced claim 規則，故未列入 findings。MRAM/ReRAM/PCRAM 等新興非揮發記憶體技術亦有搜到概念性報導（如 Utmel 文章），但缺明確發布日期，同樣未列入。

findings.claim: SK Hynix 董事長警告，全球記憶體供給到 2030 年前可能持續低於需求約 20%；多家供應商雖計畫 2027 年開出新產能，但建廠、設備安裝與原料準備會拖到 2027 下半年才有實質量產，2028 年才會有明顯產出貢獻。
findings.source: IG International, "Memory chip supercycle 2026: what is driving the DRAM, HBM rally" (citing Bank of America research)

findings.claim: Kioxia 於 1 月確認其 2026 全年 NAND 產出已全數被訂走，部分大型雲端客戶要求延伸至 2027、2028 年的供貨協議；TrendForce 判斷 NAND 有意義的產能擴張要到 2027 年底或 2028 年才會出現。
findings.source: TrendForce press release, "Diverging Memory Market Outlook in 2027 as DRAM Supply Remains Tight While NAND Flash Supply Conditions Ease"

findings.claim: 三星與 SK 海力士（合計約占全球 DRAM 產能 70%）向投資人表態不打算積極擴產，維持紀律性產出以在當前價位下最大化獲利；TrendForce 判斷 2026 年記憶體業維持保守資本支出，對位元供給成長影響有限。
findings.source: TrendForce press release, "Memory Industry to Maintain Cautious CapEx in 2026, with Limited Impact on Bit Supply Growth"

findings.claim: SK 海力士 2026 年資本支出預估達 205 億美元（年增 17%），主要投入 M15X 廠的 HBM4 產能擴充；三星 2026 年資本支出約 200 億美元（年增 11%），聚焦 1c 製程 HBM 產能與小幅擴充 P4L 晶圓產能。兩者新增資本支出多導向 HBM，一般伺服器與消費型 DRAM 的增量產能因此受限。
findings.source: Global Semi Research Substack, "2026 Memory Industry Insights" (citing SK hynix/Samsung capex guidance)

findings.claim: SK 海力士表示 DRAM 供給緊俏狀況將延續至 2026 下半年；DRAM 業潔淨室產能有限，僅三星與 SK 海力士能小幅擴充產線，其餘同業擴產空間受限。
findings.source: Suntsu Blog, "Memory Market Update Q2 2026: Navigating the Shortage"

cyclical_supply_discipline_capacity.note: 三大廠（Samsung／SK Hynix／Micron）一致展現產能紀律，新資本支出集中在 HBM 而非一般 DRAM/NAND 位元供給；新產能實質開出時間點延到 2027 下半年至 2028 年。

findings.claim: TrendForce report: AI server demand driving memory contract price increases in 2Q26; conventional DRAM contract prices forecast to rise 58-63% QoQ, NAND Flash contract prices forecast to rise 70-75% QoQ, as CSPs secure supply via long-term agreements.

findings.claim: TrendForce spot price update: DRAM spot prices extending a gradual downtrend on contained selling pressure, with DDR4 spot dropping 1.18% in the week, even as DRAM contract prices continued rising in the same period.
findings.source: TrendForce, "[Insights] Memory Spot Price Update: DRAM Extends Gradual Downtrend on Contained Selling Pressure; DDR4 Drops 1.18%", https://www.trendforce.com/news/2026/04/08/insights-memory-spot-price-update-dram-extends-gradual-downtrend-on-contained-selling-pressure-ddr4-drops-1-18/

findings.claim: TrendForce: AI server demand continues to support memory prices into 3Q26, but price gains are moderating versus Q2 as consumer demand weakens and high year-over-year base effects take hold; DRAM contract prices forecast to rise only 13-18% QoQ (vs 58-63% in Q2), NAND Flash contract prices forecast to rise 10-15% QoQ (vs 70-75% in Q2).
findings.source: TrendForce, "AI Server Demand Continues to Support Memory Prices in 3Q26, but Gains Moderate as Consumer Demand Weakens and High Base Effects Take Hold", https://www.trendforce.com/presscenter/news/20260703-13134.html

findings.claim: Contract and spot memory prices diverged sharply by mid-2026: DDR4 8Gb contract price rose from $11.50 (January) to $24.00 (July), a 109% YTD increase; 128Gb MLC NAND contract price rose from $9.46 to $30.05, a 218% YTD increase. Meanwhile spot prices lost momentum — DDR4 1Gx8 spot chips rose only 0.17% week-over-week ($42.04→$42.11) and 512Gb TLC wafer spot prices rose 4.55% but on thin trading volume, signaling weak end-demand pull-through even as contract prices (allocation-driven, tied to AI/HBM capacity diversion) hit record highs.
findings.source: BigGo Finance, "Memory Price Rally Diverges: Contract Prices Hit Record Highs in July as Spot Market Momentum Fades", https://finance.biggo.com/news/592b3c55-bfb8-488e-89aa-70632fd3c331

findings.claim: Micron Technology 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended May 28, 2026 (FY2026 Q3): ending inventory was $8.6 billion with days of inventory at 120, reflecting DRAM conditions still below target inventory days industry-wide and supporting continued pricing power across mainstream and AI-optimized parts.
findings.source: Micron Technology Inc, Form 10-Q FY2026 Q3 (SEC EDGAR filing mu-20260528.htm), https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000723125/000072312526000015/mu-20260528.htm
